scope: Retained original duty dispositions; later V19 and selected secondary progress are separately assessed in D_1.md. Inherited limitations remain explicit.

duties.title: admitted bounded computation
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Extended finite implementation: owned selection, labels, bits, hard state and public reports use admitted information and explicit tariffs. Structural execution has its separate nine-fixture/runtime scope; no global CPU/heap or malicious-code guarantee. New support: A specified ordinary producer and independent recipient use inert bounded evidence, caller-supplied current/source records, owned state, and charged construction, checking, serialization and publication. The unchanged actual consumer-cap run records both completed and denied paths. Limits: At most ten bits, one rank tier, bounded input grammar, input and computed rational caps, packet/state limits and trusted owned-process assumptions remain. Source enrollment is declared capacity accounting. Neither this event/byte tariff nor the prior broker word tariff is a general physical CPU/heap or hostile-code guarantee.

duties.title: evidence and failure states
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Checked answers, pending/unknown, conflict, stale scope and resource/receipt failure remain distinct. Failed prefixes retain their bills and are never scored as observed false labels. New support: Successful publication of a current bound, explicit paid no-current-certificate output, stale authority, representation rejection and resource failure are distinct. All 49 capped failures and the 17 rational-retry failures retain their bills; a failure is never relabeled a false mathematical bound. Limits: This subservice does not implement a new forecast, pending/conflict probability state, or universal diagnostic of why a statement is false. Saved ResourceExhausted fields identify a stage, not the rejected charge or exact ceiling branch. Lower-than-minimum account rejection and admitted paid failures retain their separate source-defined roles.

duties.title: represented Boolean coherence
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Earlier conditional finite semantics are inherited. The hard store represents only a conjunction of received coordinates; the numerical forecast vector is not a coherent joint law and does not implement unreceived entailment closure. New support: Exact Boolean/rational diagram denotations and checked expression linkage give meaning to the new deterministic proof service. They do not change the earlier probability-state result. Limits: The P3-08 forecast vector remains distinct from a coherent joint law; its hard store represents received coordinates, not unreceived arithmetic closure. No new probability or expectation state, additivity theorem or implication-respecting forecast update is implemented here.

duties.title: hard resolution and dependencies
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: The finite owned-broker integration gap is closed: sound current receipts harden eligible coordinates, preserve old forecasts and invalidate stale authority. Exact translations and predictable snapshots justify the composed performance estimates. New support: Full current records, supplied incumbents and bounds, unique IDs within an owned session, independently reconstructed violation goals and a paid final state publication determine current certificate authority. Unconditional denotational facts can survive eligible edits; conditional old warrants require current antecedent checks. Limits: The accepted finite CNF broker integration remains closed only for its earlier source and hypotheses. This ADD/native certificate service has not been joined to that learner or its forecast dependencies. No new evidence correction to forecast coordinates, joint logical reasoner, or alteration of immutable historical forecasts is claimed.

duties.title: eventual correctness
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Earlier fixed-query results retain their stream, soundness and capacity premises. Retaining one current exact answer is not a proof that all unresolved queries will be discovered, or a new infinite-stream convergence theorem. New support: Every successful current receipt has the stated conditional soundness argument. Explicit valid-input arithmetic obstructions and funded delivery failures clarify availability limits. Limits: Earlier fixed-query convergence and eventual-correctness claims retain their original stream, soundness and capacity premises. The deployed arithmetic formats are not nested; more worker budget does not remove a format cap. Finite successful delivery and later recovery do not imply eventual resolution of every query or affordable uninterrupted service.

duties.title: prediction before resolution
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: New issued forecasts and all paid advice precede current receipts. Exact repeat reuse is post-resolution knowledge, not anticipatory learning. An economical advantage on fresh mathematics remains open. New support: Previously checked structure can reduce subsequent proof work under a declared history, and the full construction/export/fresh-checking route is polynomial for the named cap-relaxed parity family under explicit primitive assumptions. Limits: Post-resolution proof reuse and a proved shortcut for a supplied family are not forecasts made before its own resolution. No new pre-resolution learner, economical discovery on fresh mathematics, or asymptotic physical-runtime claim is introduced. Ordinary algorithms receive the same shortcut and history access.

duties.title: calibration
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Earlier calibration/selected-feature scope remains separate. Aggregate Brier/action confidence intervals establish no calibration, coherent law or Logical Induction non-exploitation claim. New support: No new calibration claim is made. This deterministic receiving experiment leaves the separately accepted calibration and selected-feature work intact. Limits: Successful certificates, pass counts, source agreement, price frontiers and capped delivery fractions are not calibration, statistical coverage, a probability law or Logical Induction non-exploitation. Earlier calibration claims retain their exact bins, selections, weights, feedback and divergence assumptions.

duties.title: fixed-expert learning bounds
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: The accepted base selective-feedback path is retained. Sound corrections transfer applicable upper bounds against the original fixed experts, not against an expert upgraded with the realized hard-answer mask. Adaptive-policy regret and greedy-action guarantees are not imported. New support: The earlier selective-feedback and applicable hard-correction upper-bound transport remain the learning results. The new service has no numerical mixture or update rule. Limits: The comparator remains the original fixed experts under the accepted scoring, timing and propensity assumptions, not experts upgraded with a realized hard mask. A shared proof kernel, successful deterministic receipt, or cost saving cannot import adaptive-policy regret, greedy-action guarantees or efficient-trader immunity.

duties.title: feedback timing and selection
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Exact positive propensities, exogenous tapes, frozen blocks and one successful selected receipt remain essential. The live correction has its own argument; arbitrary missing, delayed or action-dependent discovery needs another one. New support: Owned request sequencing, acknowledged fact bases, paid failed attempts and withdrawal of stale current authority specify certificate timing. The capped histories show that failure and eviction can change later evidence paths. Limits: There is no new positive propensity law, delayed-feedback wrapper, missing-label correction or action-dependent discovery theorem. Earlier frozen-block, exogenous-tape and selected-receipt conditions are unchanged. Historical successful delivery sets are not simultaneous current receipt authority.

duties.title: typed values and losses
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Deterministic truth, hard evidence, fallible forecasts, action lotteries, realized loss, confidence intervals and resource invoices are distinct. The structural event tariff is separate from the word tariff. New support: The supplied loss difference, requested rational bound, nonempty incumbent-sublevel guarantee, proof evidence, current receipt, total and consumer invoices, live-state periods, and post-disposal observations have separate types and roles. Limits: None of these objects silently becomes a probability, expectation, realized loss, optimal bound, acquired incumbent or hardware time. A uniform bound is not necessarily tight. Source-hash capacities, actual transmitted bytes and observed event counts remain different tariff categories.

duties.title: information recovery
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Earlier finite source/fiber characterizations remain. The new exact shared-residual identities recover specified loss relationships, not an entire probability law or extra mathematical answers from a scalar cost. New support: The ADD bridge constructively exports one explicitly requested current inequality service from a producer into independently checked evidence. It clarifies which output service is obtained from a richer internal representation. Limits: Earlier finite source/fiber and public loss-identity results retain their scopes. This receipt does not recover a full probability law, every consequence, optimizing identities, or all producer information. A constant-size final root does not account for its input linkage or entire evidence history.

duties.title: forecast-to-action bridge
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Sound pointwise corrections and the fixed-end action argument apply to the named lottery. Ordinary greedy rules use explicit known-stakes algebra; their cost estimates are not assumed uniformly accurate and need not improve realized loss. New support: Under the supplied common loss interpretation, a nonpositive uniform difference bound on a nonempty domain can warrant the named deterministic robust action comparison. The entire incumbent sublevel is covered. Limits: The experiment supplies the incumbent and requested bound equally; it does not acquire them, optimize the bound, choose a minimizing action or learn action-cost errors. The earlier lottery/known-stakes bridges remain separate, and the elementary uniform-error-to-decision-loss result gets no new rate or stronger premise here.

duties.title: paid resources and usefulness
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Source, inference, acquisition, checking, storage, readout and admitted failures have explicit finite accounts and separate completion conditions. No optimal value-of-computation or physical-runtime theorem is established. New support: Complete invoices charge source, construction, old/current inputs, edits, export, recipient checks, live serialized state, publication and failed attempts. Primary all-success paths, exact fixed-invoice repricing, and the actual 239-delivery/49-failure consumer-cap histories are separate. The latter show 12 unique discrepancies with static primary affordability predicates. Limits: The event/byte model excludes apparatus and declared installed infrastructure, is tied to CPython 3.12.14, and does not measure physical CPU/heap. Empty deltas accrue chunk/ID history; epoch receipt caps and rebuilding remain. Pruning raises every matched total. Actual-cap total dominance is not consumer-vector dominance: resident k5 warm ADD uses fewer consumer units than direct checking on the same delivered IDs. No optimal value-of-computation rule, universal amortization theorem or successful-path inference from a relabeled budget is obtained.

duties.title: scoped models and ordinary comparison
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Exact, cached, greedy, proof-only, fixed-action and identical-kernel controls are retained. The finite synthesis remains useful at its stated scope; affirmative Q3 economic advantage remains open. New support: Two checked old conditional domains have complementary applicability on every declared edit and a verified five-node reuse cover. Ordinary controls receive those same inputs and the same portfolio kernel. Direct ordinary checking is least total in all eight complete primary cells; under the actual cap it provides superset delivered coverage at lower total in every complete cell. Limits: The old warrants are sound conditional facts, not learned fallible empirical models. Two-warrant necessity is restricted to the fixed identity-mapped reuse cover. The inherited fresh-tree obstruction does not apply to shared DAGs or every ordinary proof. Reuse's cold-ADD crossings in two of three resident nonconstant streams do not defeat the stronger catalogue. Affirmative Q3/P3-H03 remains OPEN.

duties.title: scope, version and withdrawal
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Hard generations prevent old-name revival; structural reads reject changed warrants before recheck/transport. Reports retain their historical scope, and changed stakes or objectives require the corresponding current warrant. New support: The receiver binds expected source, bit count/order/coordinate epoch, actual owned base facts, full current records and unique session request IDs. Current goals are independently rebuilt; conditional old-domain warrants must discharge their transported antecedents. Paid publication is transactional, and failed attempts expose no stale current receipt. Limits: Equal base counts are not a prefix-content hash or proof of identical history; local checks use actual owned facts. Source digests do not authenticate a malicious host. Unconditional facts do not become false merely because a new current goal fails; the measured policy conservatively evicts scientific state while retaining completed source installation. Reuse across a changed interpreter/coordinate environment needs fresh binding or justified transport.

duties.title: distinct hypothetical changes
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Conditioning, occurrence, actor, shared code, stored-copy/predictor replacement and paired-support repair have separate executed interfaces. No general new counterfactual semantics is selected. New support: The current hard/rank/loss edits exercise the inherited receiving interpretation with explicit versioned records, maps, incumbents and bounds. Limits: These edits do not erase distinctions among conditioning, occurrence/token intervention, actor-only replacement, shared replacement, stored-copy changes, repair and exceptional evaluation. No general new counterfactual semantics is selected or automatically imported from diagram equality.

duties.title: structural identification
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Dependency and repair information are supplied. Unresolved sources remain outside minimization; neither implementation identifies an absent causal structure or an objectively preferred exception policy. New support: Successful receipt checking is conditional on the supplied finite structural/repair frame, rank, interpretation and chosen incumbent. Limits: The bridge does not identify missing causal structure, resolve observationally indistinguishable alternatives, learn a preferred repair ranking, or justify an exception policy. A unique implementation output is a selected reporting service, not uniquely identified structural truth.

duties.title: feasibility, ties and decisions
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Complete tied minima and feasibility checks are charged. One implementable receiving action is distinguished from the forbidden casewise oracle; infeasibility supplies no useful-action warrant. New support: The receiver independently verifies the supplied feasible incumbent and bounds every point in its current rank sublevel, hence all minimizing ties. The twelve complementary edits retain named exclusive sublevel witnesses and verified five-node covers. An equisatisfiable subset of the domain cannot replace this coverage obligation. Limits: The incumbent need not be optimal; exclusive witnesses are not always minimizers. The service neither enumerates all minimizer identities nor chooses among their consequences. Failed or empty selection does not warrant useful action. Coverage of previously delivered requests under a budget is a different set from the assignment domain of one receipt.

duties.title: genuine counterpossibles
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: The original classical contradiction remains unsatisfiable and the exceptional paired-support rules are explicit. This finite structural test has not been joined to the selective-feedback learner. New support: The prior finite counterpossible adapter and its explicit exceptional rules remain separate evidence. This recurrence adds no counterpossible theorem. Limits: Ordinary parity reassociation, consistent current edits, bound failure or exact-arithmetic rejection are not analyses of an original impossible antecedent. Topic preservation, justification of exceptional policies and composition with feedback remain open in their earlier scopes; source-bound certificate transport does not supply them.

duties.title: operational equivalence
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Kernel identity, complete-key routing and selected-receipt coupling identify the mathematical paths actually preserved. Invoices may change. Repricing a fixed record differs from rerunning a price-sensitive acquisition policy; matching nine outputs is not a universal representation theorem. New support: The new ordinary DAG and native formats establish the same named current service through independently checked input linkage, nonemptiness and whole-sublevel coverage. The ordinary ADD-to-portfolio adapter admits only actually checked evidence. The parity family has a complete polynomial shared construction/export/fresh-checking route under explicit uncapped-schema assumptions, against an exponential fresh inherited-tree format. Limits: The two deployed arithmetic admission domains are not nested; the adapter is narrower still at the computed-cutoff boundary. Equal successful service does not imply equal internal state, proof length, invoices, availability under another budget or total bidirectional translation. This is a fragment-relative algorithmic and representation distinction, not a general certificate lower bound, generic polynomial compiler or physical speed theorem.

duties.title: versioned self-assessment
duties.retained_scope: Inherited scope retained: Paid public reporting reconstructs the current episode without unbought labels. It provides no self-proof, endogenous-feedback reflection, future guarantee, anytime coverage or empirical proof of fair randomness. New support: Versioned sources, frozen run manifests, independently reconstructed records and preserved failures make the current experiment auditable. The original rational-log inconsistency and separately attributed unchanged retry remain explicit. Limits: External observer inspection is not a deployed self-model, self-proof, live forecast, reflection theorem or report-dependent feedback guarantee. The earlier paid public episode reports retain their own exogeneity, information, fixed-end and source assumptions. Audit runtimes and agent work add no principal research credit, and scientific support does not close the task floor or later gates.
